legend: Cláudia is an outstanding researcher and is always looking for new challenges. Thus, she decides to attack the root of all evil in society: the Matrix.
The Matrix can be seen as an N×N$$$N \times N$$$ binary grid, that is, a table with N$$$N$$$ rows and N$$$N$$$ columns consisting only of 0$$$0$$$s and 1$$$1$$$s.
With all her knowledge, Cláudia can perform two operations on the Matrix:

Choose two integers i$$$i$$$ and j$$$j$$$ (1≤i,j≤N$$$1 \le i, j \le N$$$ and i≠j$$$i \ne j$$$) and swap column i$$$i$$$ with column j$$$j$$$ of the grid, that is, for all 1≤k≤N$$$1 \le k \le N$$$, swap the positions (k,i)$$$(k, i)$$$ and (k,j)$$$(k, j)$$$ of the grid;

Choose two integers i$$$i$$$ and j$$$j$$$ (1≤i,j≤N$$$1 \le i, j \le N$$$ and i≠j$$$i \ne j$$$) and swap row i$$$i$$$ with row j$$$j$$$ of the grid, that is, for all 1≤k≤N$$$1 \le k \le N$$$, swap the positions (i,k)$$$(i, k)$$$ and (j,k)$$$(j, k)$$$ of the grid;

Thus, to demonstrate her dominance over the Matrix, Cláudia decides to form a C (for Cláudia) in the cells of the Matrix made up of 1$$$1$$$s. We say that a C of size x$$$x$$$ made up of 1$$$1$$$s exists in the grid if, for a pair of integers a$$$a$$$ and b$$$b$$$ (1≤a,b≤N$$$1 \le a, b \le N$$$), the positions (a+i,b)$$$(a + i, b)$$$, (a,b+i)$$$(a, b + i)$$$, and (a+x,b+i)$$$(a + x, b + i)$$$ of the grid contain 1$$$1$$$s for all 0≤i≤x−1$$$0 \le i \le x - 1$$$.
Help Cláudia by telling, for a given configuration of the Matrix, what is the largest C she can form using the operations at her disposal.
Due to the time limit of the problem, it is important to submit Python solutions using the PyPy3 compiler.
input: The first line of the input contains an integer N$$$N$$$ (1≤N≤500$$$1 \le N \le 500$$$).

There will be N$$$N$$$ following lines, where the i$$$i$$$-th (1≤i≤N$$$1 \le i \le N$$$) contains N$$$N$$$ integers, where the j$$$j$$$-th (1≤j≤N$$$1 \le j \le N$$$) is the value ai,j$$$a_{i,j}$$$ (0≤ai,j≤1$$$0 \le a_{i,j} \le 1$$$) at position (i,j)$$$(i, j)$$$ of the Matrix grid.
output: Print a single integer — the side length of the largest C made up of 1$$$1$$$s that can be formed by performing any number of operations.
